passage:
A city launched a website connecting volunteers with local needs: tutoring, beach cleaning, food delivery, elderly visits, and translation help.
Many young people joined because the website made opportunities easy to find.
However, some organizations received too many short-term volunteers and not enough trained long-term help. The platform added clearer descriptions of time, skills, and responsibility.
Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up. It is matching real needs.
Digital platforms can make kindness easier to organize, but they must not turn service into a quick badge. People need commitment, not only clicks.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A city launched a website connecting volunteers with local needs: tutoring, beach cleaning, food delivery, elderly visits, and…”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Digital Volunteer Platform: A city launched a website connecting volunteers with local needs: tutoring, beach cleaning, food delivery, elderly visits, and…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

本文沒有陳述「The Digital Twin City」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Digital Pet」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
